answer.restated_question: If I must take only unplaceable tiles and I'm the first to pick from the center this round, what happens with the starting player marker?

evidence.quote: If you are the first player in this round to pick tiles from the center of the table, also take the starting player marker

steps.text: The first player to take from the center also takes the starting player marker and puts it on the leftmost free floor space.
steps.title: First center pick

evidence.quote: If you have the starting player marker in your floor line, it counts as a normal tile there.

steps.text: In the floor line the marker counts as a normal tile, so it costs points like any other floor tile.

evidence.quote: But instead of placing it in the lid, place it in front of you.

steps.text: The marker takes the leftmost free floor space, and your picked tiles fill the spaces after it, left to right. You become starting player next round, and the marker's penalty applies at Wall-tiling; afterwards it goes in front of you, not in the lid.
